title: केलत्वाःया अभिलेख
nepali: लः त्वनेगु पदार्थ खः । थ्व अन्न नं खः । अन्न सय्‌केत लः मदय्‌‌क मगाःगुलिं हे थुकियात अन्न धाःगु खः । जीवन निर्वाह याय्‌ धुंकाः जीवनयात परिशुद्धिया नितिं नं लः माः । थुकथं जीवनया हरेक ख्यलय्‌ माःगु लखं हे सभ्यता दय्‌‌की । लः मदय्‌‌क सभ्यता न्ह्याइमखु । नेपाःगाःया येँ देय्‌ दुने नं थौंया सघन येँ देय्‌ लखं हे विकास जूगु वस्ती खः । प्यखेरं खुसि न्ह्यानाच्वंसां नगर निर्माणया नितिं उगु लः नगर दुने हय्‌‌मफयाः लिच्छविकाल न्ह्यःतक बन्जर वा सुख्खा येँ देसय्‌ दकले न्हापां मानदेवं लः हःगु खः । थ्व हे लः हःगु प्रसंग दुथ्यानाच्वंगु अभिलेख खः केलत्वाःया अभिलेख । थुकी लः हया धकाः न्ह्यथने धुंकाः थ्व लागाय्‌ चहपह अप्वल । अझ मेमेगु भौतिक संरचना निर्माणलिसें स्वापू दुगु अभिलेख लुयावःगु आधारय्‌ हाडिगाँ वा नरलय्‌ न्यनाच्वंगु नेपाःगाःया सभ्यता येँ देसय्‌ विस्तार जुल धाय्‌‌फु । उकिं केलया अभिलेख येँ देय्‌‌या जीवनसूचक खः । थ्व हे लखं थनया लः सम्पदायात जक मखु थन सुख्खा भूमी नं जीवन थनेगु ज्या याःगु दु ।
american_english: Water is a drinkable substance. It is also food. Because crops cannot ripen without water, that is precisely why it has been called food. After sustaining life, water is also required for the purification of life. In this way, water, being required in every realm of life, creates civilization. Civilization cannot progress without water. Within Kathmandu City of the Nepal Valley, today's dense Kathmandu City is also a settlement that developed through water. Even though rivers flowed on all four sides, because that water could not be brought into the city for urban construction, Manadeva was the very first to bring water into Kathmandu City, which had been barren or dry prior to the Lichhavi period. The inscription containing this context of bringing water is the Kel Tole inscription. After mentioning that water was brought here, activity in this area increased. Furthermore, on the basis of discovered inscriptions related to the construction of other physical infrastructure, it can be said that the civilization of the Nepal Valley, which had been spread across Hadigaun or Naral, expanded into Kathmandu City. Therefore, the Kel inscription is an indicator of life for Kathmandu City. This very water served not only the local water heritage, but also breathed life into the arid land here.
